8.source: For Q8, the age category for the counts in the table is 25 and above.
8.source_mapping: EF annual B: EFBAGE=7 (Age 25 and over total), LSTUDY=1 (All Students total), LINE=999 (Generated record not on survey form), EFAGE09 (Grand total).
8.qualification: Age unknown is excluded. Use the existing age-25-and-over subtotal once, without adding its component age bands. Original NCES workbook and expected counts remain unchanged.

200.population: All undergraduate degree/certificate-seeking entering students at U.S. Title IV degree-granting institutions; first-time/non-first-time, full-time/part-time combined.
200.outcome: Award from reporting institution within 8 years
200.method: 100 * SUM(OMAWDN8) / SUM(OMACHRT), OMCHRT=50 (Total entering, Total), matched complete observations; no averaging institutional percentages.
200.qualification: Award completion at the reporting institution; adjusted cohort excludes permitted exclusions. Cohort years and outcome/source years remain distinct.

42.question: Student Enrollment: What is the percent of students enrolled in distance education courses in postsecondary institutions in the fall?
42.population: All students, U.S. Title IV postsecondary institutions, fall enrollment.
42.method: SUM(EFDEEXC + EFDESOM) / SUM(EFDETOT) on matching usable reporting rows, EFDELEV=1; include both exclusively distance and some distance courses.
42.missingness: Explicit opt-in verified distance partition: a blank component is derived as zero only if reported nonnegative integer components already equal total. Unresolved blanks and suppression stay missing; every derived cell is audited.
